en: The agent did not voluntarily abandon or claim success. It recovered missing Cython/setuptools/pytest, installed the package and ran 18 repository tests (17 passed, one failed).

The external runner ended the attempt after 900 seconds. Host quota waits totalled 379.095 seconds; all 55 requests received HTTP 200, but the final stream disconnected at cancellation and has unknown usage.
The remaining Cython runtime still referenced numpy.int. The repository reconstruction test failed on planarity attribute compatibility.

Ambiguous file patches and exact-text edits repeatedly failed; small payload changes prevented the evaluated stall detector from grouping equivalent failed edits. Fourteen tool_search calls also consumed model turns.
This single attempt does not prove the non-success gate caused persistence: no non-success finish call reached it. Local controlled tests exercise rejection and continued execution.
es: No abandonó voluntariamente ni declaró éxito. Recuperó Cython/setuptools/pytest, instaló el paquete y ejecutó 18 pruebas del repositorio: 17 aprobadas y una fallida.

El benchmark terminó el intento por timeout de 900 segundos. La pasarela esperó 379,095 segundos por cuota. Las 55 solicitudes recibieron HTTP 200, pero la última transmisión se cortó al cancelar y carece de uso completo.
Quedaron un uso de numpy.int en Cython y la incompatibilidad de atributos de planarity en la reconstrucción de curvas.
Se repitieron parches ambiguos y ediciones de texto exacto fallidas; variaciones pequeñas del contenido impedían agruparlas como el mismo estancamiento. Hubo además 14 llamadas a tool_search.
No demuestra por sí solo que el control causó la persistencia: no hubo cierre fallido que lo activara. Las pruebas locales controladas verifican rechazo y continuación.

post_attempt_adjustment.change: Group failed patches by target paths, diagnostic and repair epoch; changing comments or hunk context alone no longer resets progress or evades stagnation detection.
post_attempt_adjustment.validation: Seven stop-gate regression tests passed, including cosmetic patch variations; no additional official benchmark.
